title: Waukesha County Historical Society & Museum

services.name: Exhibits & Collections
services.desc: For more than 100 years, the WCHSM has dedicated itself to preserving and sharing the county’s cultural heritage. The artifact and archival collection includes more than 18,000 objects, 250,000 images, millions of archival materials, and innumerable stories that make up the community of Waukesha County. With an annual donation of $35 you’ll support the direct cost of collections care including: storage cartons & boxes, protective foam, digitization tools, environmental monitoring, and conservation & cleaning. Rescued by Adelle Krebs, sold to Stan Borgstrom, given to John Schoenknecht, painted on front by MCA, back has “M. Laflin Waukesha” written on it (delivery instructions) and “No. 9”
